verdict.rationale: Ollama runs as a local HTTP server: there is a REST API with an OpenAPI spec served at localhost:11434, a shell install script, and community reports of shipped ROCm containers and long-running Linux inference even though the desktop app was not available on Linux. Together these imply headless server operation. However, no first-party doc explicitly describes running without a GUI, a serve or daemon mode, or CI usage. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of headless/daemon operation (e.g. a serve command or systemd service), official container/Docker docs, and documented CI-pipeline usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
I've been using it in Linux for inference for ages.
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
